cases.input: Import the same scoped export twice.
cases.expect: One task and transition set remain with zero assertion churn.

cases.input: A newer crosswalk remaps an existing source transition.
cases.expect: Source-event identity remains stable and a versioned mapping assertion supersedes the old mapping.

cases.input: Two transitions have the same occurrence second and distinct source ordinals.
A task moves container and its human key changes.
cases.expect: Canonical taskId and immutable source item ID stay stable; aliases are effective-dated.

cases.input: Two aliases claim master over the same interval.
cases.expect: A surfaced conflict is created and neither claim silently wins.

cases.input: Native status is Closed/Fixed with no acceptance evidence.
cases.expect: Accepted is not asserted; absence remains open-world.
The prior outcome is explicitly superseded or retracted; history remains.

cases.input: A native status has no crosswalk entry.
cases.expect: A queryable loss record is written; no default canonical state is invented.

cases.input: A restricted export omits a field visible in another scope.
cases.expect: The field is absent under the recorded scope, never interpreted as empty.

cases.input: An item is absent from a later export with no deletion event.
cases.expect: No tombstone is created until deletion is positively observed.

cases.input: One item has different ranks in two selection contexts.
cases.expect: Ranks coexist as context-item facts and do not mutate Task.

cases.input: A Kanban source has no iteration.
cases.expect: Task state, transitions and outcomes remain complete without Iteration.

cases.input: An estimate changes from points to hours.
cases.expect: Separate revisions retain unit scheme versions and are not numerically compared without a declared conversion.

cases.input: A locally written update is re-imported from the source.
cases.expect: Write provenance suppresses an echo assertion while preserving the observation.

cases.input: A transition predates the currently active lifecycle definition.
cases.expect: Occurrence-time-valid version is used or mapping is explicitly retrospective.
